dashboard.title: Researcher dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Real progress, not performance theatre
dashboard.emptyState: No data yet. Start with an idea, a thesis, a literature collection, or a dataset.

provenance.noFabrication: Nothing is shown without a source or an approval.

facts.title: Review extracted facts
facts.subtitle: Nothing here is stored as a fact yet. Approval is yours alone.
facts.approved: Approved and promoted to verified memory
facts.groundingNote: Every quote shown here exists verbatim in the source file; anything else was auto-rejected before reaching you.

memory.title: Verified memory
memory.subtitle: Only what you approved, with its source and location.
memory.empty: Verified memory is empty. Start from the fact review screen.

profile.title: Academic profile
profile.subtitle: What you declare yourself, and what was approved from your documents.

agents.title: Agents and constraints
agents.subtitle: What an agent cannot do is shown here — not promised in a hidden prompt.
agents.toolsNote: No tool in the platform mutates raw data, decides an approval, or writes verified memory.

traces.title: Execution trace
traces.subtitle: Every agent run with its tools, models, guardrails and cost.
traces.blockedNote: This output was blocked and never shown to the user.

portfolio.title: Research portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Parallel papers serving one scientific line.
portfolio.suggestionOnly: A re-orderable suggestion, not a fixed rule.

library.title: Evidence library
library.subtitle: Every source with its access state, retraction status and last verification.
library.notFound: This identifier was not found in any scholarly registry; no substitute reference will be created.

claims.title: Claims ledger
claims.subtitle: Every substantive claim with its evidence and support level.
claims.gapNote: A claim without evidence is declared a gap; no reference is generated for it.
claims.contradictionNote: Contradictory evidence is shown, never hidden, and blocks closing the claim until resolved.

thread.title: Golden Thread Lab
thread.subtitle: From problem to recommendation, with no missing link.
thread.noProject: Select a project to view its thread.
thread.scoreNote: The score is indicative; it must not be used alone as a final verdict.
thread.gateNote: The gate opens on the absence of blocking findings, not on reaching a score.
thread.missingList: The missing elements, by name — each one blocks the gate until it is added:
thread.allPresent: The thread is complete: all nine elements are present.
thread.groupRequired: Elements whose absence blocks the gate
thread.addTitle: Add an element to the thread
thread.addNote: The addition is written to the audit log under your name, and the score is re-read from the server afterwards — the interface never computes it.

theses.title: Thesis library
theses.subtitle: From a thesis to legitimate papers, not republished chapters.
theses.rightsNote: The rights basis is a claim the researcher records; approval is a separate decision at gate GT1.
theses.addNote: Registration records the thesis; it grants no right: the basis of use stays a claim until the GT1 gate. Parsing a thesis requires its file to be attached.

opportunities.title: Publication map
opportunities.subtitle: Every opportunity with its readiness, overlap and gate status.
opportunities.empty: No opportunities yet. Start from the thesis library.
opportunities.overlapNote: Overlap is a review signal, not a plagiarism verdict; the decision is human.
opportunities.analysisNote: Analysing an opportunity is allowed before rights; only advancing it is not.

manuscripts.title: Manuscript factory
manuscripts.subtitle: Build the manuscript section by section, tying every result to an analysis run.
manuscripts.gateNote: Gate G9 does not open by clicking: every unsupported claim, and every result with no analysis run, stays a blocker. The server enforces it; this screen only explains it.

analysis.title: Analysis engine
analysis.subtitle: From raw data to interpretation, along an unbroken evidence chain.
analysis.frozenNote: Analysis runs only on a frozen dataset version, and a plan cannot be edited once locked.
analysis.harkingNote: The plan is locked before results are seen, so the hypothesis cannot be written after they appear.

trends.title: Proactive intelligence
trends.subtitle: Watch research trends and turn them into actionable opportunities.
trends.evidenceNote: No orphan signals: every signal carries a source, an identifier and a date. Model output is recorded but never counted as evidence.
trends.twoScoresNote: Trend strength and opportunity fit are two separate scores and are never merged: a strong trend can still be a poor fit for this researcher right now.
trends.p14Note: Authorizing a submission is a human act recorded against its author; the system never submits anything externally on its own.

approvals.title: Decisions awaiting approval
approvals.subtitle: §9 gates and integrity alerts in one place.
approvals.noTimeoutNote: No gate closes by timeout: an approval waits for a human indefinitely, and the requester cannot decide their own request.
approvals.reasonLabel: Reason (required for approval and rejection alike)
approvals.reasonRequired: A decision needs a written reason — rejection as much as approval.
approvals.resolutionRequired: Resolving an alert needs a written rationale.
approvals.noDeleteNote: An integrity alert is never deleted: it is resolved with a rationale that stays on the record.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: A hash-chained event log — read only.
audit.appendOnlyNote: There is no edit or delete button here because the log itself refuses both: the privileges are revoked in the database and a trigger blocks the rest.
audit.chainBroken: Chain broken — the log was touched outside the application
audit.adminOnlyNote: This screen is for administrative roles only (§28).

settings.title: Settings and runtime posture
settings.subtitle: What the system does right now, and what it does not.
settings.readOnlyNote: This screen discloses; it does not change anything. Configuration lives in the environment, not the browser. No key is shown — only whether one is set.

team.title: Project team and decisions
team.subtitle: Who contributed what, and what was decided when.
team.creditNote: CRediT roles are selected by hand, never suggested from your activity on the platform: suggesting them turns “who did what” from a declaration into an inference.
team.decisionHistoryNote: Superseded decisions stay visible: hiding them makes the log look as if the current view were the only one ever held.

briefs.title: Intelligence brief
briefs.subtitle: What changed in your trends and opportunities this period.
briefs.evidenceNote: Every item carries its reference. An item without one is a rumour, and the contract rejects it before it reaches this page.
briefs.emptyPeriodNote: Monitoring ran this period and found nothing worth showing — which is not the same as not running.
